            <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:attribute-category:resource" AttributeId="urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
          </Match>
        </AllOf>
      </AnyOf>
    </Target>
    <Condition>
      <Apply FunctionId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:function:any-of">
        <Function FunctionId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-regexp-match"/>
        <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">uid=pep-wsfed-authzen(-central|-local)?,ou=users,dc=.+</AttributeValue>
        <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:attribute-category:environment" AttributeId="urn:sts:xacml:authzen:caller" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
      </Apply>
    </Condition>
  </Rule>
  <Rule RuleId="readProfile" Effect="Permit">
    <Target>
      <AnyOf>
        <AllOf>
          <Match MatchId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-equal">
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">read</AttributeValue>
            <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:attribute-category:action" AttributeId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
          </Match>
          <Match MatchId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-equal">
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">profile</AttributeValue>
            <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:attribute-category:resource" AttributeId="urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
          </Match>
        </AllOf>
      </AnyOf>
      <AnyOf>
        <AllOf>
          <Match MatchId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-equal">
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">staff</AttributeValue>
            <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:subject-category:access-subject" AttributeId="employeeType" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
          </Match>
        </AllOf>
      </AnyOf>
    </Target>
  </Rule>
  <Rule RuleId="otherwise" Effect="Deny">
    <Target/>
  </Rule>
</Policy>

<Policy xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:core:schema:wd-17" PolicyId="urn:example:wsfedauthz:shared" Version="1.0" RuleCombiningAlgId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:rule-combining-algorithm:deny-unless-permit">
  <Target/>
  <Rule RuleId="readReport" Effect="Permit">
    <Target>
      <AnyOf>
        <AllOf>
          <Match MatchId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-equal">
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">read</AttributeValue>
            <AttributeDesignator Category="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:attribute-category:action" AttributeId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string" MustBePresent="false"/>
          </Match>
          <Match MatchId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:string-equal">
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string">report</AttributeValue>

          </Match>
        </AllOf>
      </AnyOf>
    </Target>
    <Condition>

        <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer">0</AttributeValue>
      </Apply>
    </Condition>
  </Rule>
</Policy>
